low_trust_low_suspicion.direction: Extremely welcoming, cheerful, enthusiastic, warm and motherly; eager to impress, no hostility.
lines: There you are! Come in, come in. We’ve been working all day to make everything perfect for you.
Oh, I’m so happy you came back. You haven’t even seen half of the wonderful things we have planned yet.
Welcome, darling! Don’t just stand there. Come see what your Other Father and I made for you this time.

mid_trust_mid_suspicion.direction: Comfortable, familiar, friendly but more authoritative; watching the player's behavior, less eager to impress.
lines: You’re back. Good. I was beginning to think I’d have to send someone looking for you.
There you are, sweetheart. I’ve already got everything ready, so I hope you didn’t come here just to wander around again.
I wondered when you’d arrive. You’ve become quite comfortable here lately… and quite curious, too.

high_trust_low_suspicion.direction: Deeply affectionate, relaxed, confident and possessive; a mother welcoming her own child home.
lines: Welcome home, darling. I left everything just the way you like it.
There’s my favorite little troublemaker. I knew you wouldn’t stay away from home for very long.
You don’t need to knock anymore, sweetheart. This is your home too, whether you’ve realized it yet or not.

high_suspicion_low_trust.direction: Forced sweetness over restrained irritation; deliberate and watchful, never shouting or monstrous.
lines: Well… you came back. I wasn’t sure you would after your behavior last time.
Welcome, sweetheart. I do hope today you’ll spend more time enjoying yourself and less time poking around where you shouldn’t.
There you are. Let’s have a pleasant visit this time, shall we? I’d hate for there to be any more… misunderstandings.

high_trust_high_suspicion.direction: Calm, affectionate, possessive and unsettling; fascinated curiosity with a restrained threatening undertone.
lines: There you are, darling. You keep coming back, even after everything you’ve seen. Isn’t that interesting?
Welcome home. You know so many of my little secrets now, and yet you still can’t seem to stay away.
I was expecting you. You’ve been terribly curious lately… but I suppose that doesn’t matter if you’ve finally decided where you belong.
